sentences.en: My grandmother has a lot of vegetation that grows spontaneously.
sentences.zh: 我奶奶家有很多野生植物。

sentences.en: It's very difficult to navigate this very very dense vegetation.
sentences.zh: 在这种非常密集的草木中穿行非常困难。

sentences.en: Vegetation needs to flourish in these arid regions of Algeria.
sentences.zh: 这些阿尔及利亚的干旱地区需要植被繁茂起来。

senses.zh: 植物（总称），草木,医赘生物，增殖体,无所作为的生活，单调的生活,植营养体生长，发育
